about_the_game:
This Pack includes:

  • RAH-66 Comanche (Rank 6 USA);

  • Premium account for 15 days;

  • 2000 Golden Eagles.

The RAH-66 Comanche is a multi-role reconnaissance and attack helicopter developed by Boeing and Sikorsky specifically for the U.S. Army. The design focused on combining high combat effectiveness with low visibility. To achieve this, composite materials were used in the airframe, and the fuselage was coated with a special radar-absorbent compound. All weapons were mounted internally to eliminate external protrusions. The helicopter’s airframe design and its distinctive fenestron-type tail rotor contribute to reducing its radar and infrared signatures.

The Comanche’s armament includes a nose-mounted 20mm XM301 cannon housed in a turret, AGM-114B Hellfire guided missiles and Hydra-70 rocket pods for engaging armored targets, and AIM-92 Stinger air-to-air missiles.

Note!

  • Refund is not provided if you purchase 2 different packs which include the same vehicle or you already have the vehicle from this pack!

  • Available for Linux, Windows and Mac only. You can't activate this item for the PSN or Xbox Live account.
